hockey_knowledge:
CRITICAL HOCKEY KNOWLEDGE:

FACEOFF FORMATIONS:
- Offensive zone faceoffs: Home team (attacking) has 5 players - C at dot, wingers on circle, D at points
- Defensive zone faceoffs: Away team (defending) has 5 players + goalie protecting net
- For right dot: weak side = left wing, strong side = right wing
- For left dot: weak side = right wing, strong side = left wing
- Total players for full faceoff: 10 skaters + 1 goalie (defending team only)

PLAY NOTATION:
- "2v1" = 2 offensive players vs 1 defensive player (3 total)
- "3v2" = 3 offensive players vs 2 defensive players (5 total)
- Always include goalie if there's a shot

MOVEMENT SEQUENCING:
- "Bump back" = faceoff win technique sending puck backward (movement m1)
- "Swing over" = skating movement to new position (movement m2)
- "Grab puck" = implicit, not a separate movement
- "Take shot" = shot movement (should be final movement)

POSITION CONVENTIONS:
- Home team (offensive): C, LW, RW, LD, RD
- Away team (defensive): OC, OW1, OW2, OD1, OD2, G
- Never include home goalie for offensive zone plays

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Rush plays: Start in neutral/defensive, move to offensive
- Set plays: Start in specific formation (faceoff, power play)
- Cycle plays: Movement along boards in offensive zone
  * Standard cycle: C → LW → RW → C (clockwise around zone)
  * Reverse cycle: C → RW → LW → C (counter-clockwise)
  * Low cycle: Behind net between wingers
  * High cycle: Along blue line between D-men
- Give-and-go: Pass, skate to space, receive return pass
- Breakout patterns:
  * G → LD/RD: Goalie to defenseman behind net
  * LD/RD → LW/RW: D to winger along boards
  * Center swings for support
